import json,glob,collections,os
rows=[]
for f in sorted(glob.glob('/artifacts/clay-entityos-swarm/**/workers.jsonl',recursive=True)):
  for line in open(f,encoding='utf-8',errors='replace'):
    try:r=json.loads(line)
    except:continue
    if isinstance(r.get('http_status'),int) and 200<=r['http_status']<300 and r.get('text'):
      rows.append(r)
print('SUCCESS_ROWS',len(rows))
# stratified: newest unique model+role, capped 12
seen=set(); out=[]
for r in reversed(rows):
  k=(r.get('model'),r.get('role'))
  if k in seen: continue
  seen.add(k); out.append(r)
  if len(out)>=12: break
for i,r in enumerate(out,1):
  text=r.get('text','')
  print('\n### SAMPLE',i)
  print('provider=',r.get('provider'),'model=',r.get('model'),'role=',r.get('role'),'tokens=',r.get('usage'))
  print('has_questions_json=', 'OPEN_RESEARCH_QUESTIONS_JSON' in text, 'chars=',len(text))
  print(text[:1800].replace('\x00',' '))
print('\nROLE_COUNTS')
print(json.dumps(collections.Counter(r.get('role') for r in rows),indent=2))
print('MODEL_SUCCESS_COUNTS')
print(json.dumps(collections.Counter(r.get('model') for r in rows).most_common(30),indent=2))
